adjudication.rationale: In app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb, `rss.items.each do |i| ... TopicEmbed.import(...) end` has no per-item error handling. `TopicEmbed.import` can raise (e.g., `absolutize_urls` calls `URI(url)` with no rescue; `TopicEmbed.create!` can raise; and the unique index on `topic_embeds.embed_url` can raise on concurrent imports). Any such exception will abort the loop and the job, preventing remaining feed items from being processed.
